The '''Jeffery&ndash;Williams Prize''' is a mathematics award presented annually by the [[Canadian Mathematical Society]].  The award is presented to individuals in recognition of outstanding contributions to mathematical research. The first award was presented in 1968. The prize was named in honor of the mathematicians [[Ralph Lent Jeffery]] and [[William Lloyd Garrison Williams|Lloyd Williams]].
